card.title: Exam bank — every board question on circular motion

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Four board questions cover this unit: the 5-mark centripetal derivation, the flywheel numerical (rpm→rad/s), the car-turn numerical, and the satellite orbit application. Centripetal force is never a new force — always tension, friction, gravity or normal reaction playing the inward role.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: a_c = v²/r = ω²r · F_c = mv²/r · v = ωr · ω = 2πn/60 (rpm→rad/s) · banking tanθ = v²/rg · satellite v = √(GM/r)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Uniform circular motion needs constant-magnitude inward force (why derivation assumes constant v). Banking tanθ = v²/rg neglects friction — ideal design speed only. Satellite formula needs centre-to-centre r (R + h, not h) because gravity reaches from Earth's centre.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Flywheel 300 rpm = 5 rev/s → ω = 10π ≈ 31.4 rad/s (the rpm trap: divide by 60 FIRST). Car 50 m/10 m/s → ω = 0.2, a = 2. Satellite 600 km up: r = 6.4×10⁶ + 6×10⁵ = 7.0×10⁶ m — forgetting Earth's radius is the classic zero.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2023 (4): flywheel r = 0.5 m, 300 rpm → ω = 300×2π/60 = 10π ≈ 31.4 rad/s; rim v = ωr ≈ 15.7 m/s; a_c = ω²r ≈ 493 m/s². NEB 2023 (5): derivation via Δv triangle (similar triangles, Δt→0) → a = v²/r inward. NEB 2022 satellite: GMm/r² = mv²/r → v = √(GM/r) with r from Earth's centre.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: rpm without /60; orbital radius as altitude only; calling centrifugal a real force in inertial frames; vertical-circle minimum-speed condition forgotten at the top (v ≥ √(gr)).

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Only one derivation is asked: centripetal acceleration. Similar-triangles Δv/v = vΔt/r → a = v²/r, direction inward as Δt→0. Conical pendulum and banking resolve forces (vertical balances weight, horizontal supplies mv²/r) — no calculus needed.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: rpm→rad/s: ×2π/60 first line, always. Turn/banking: resolve vertical vs horizontal. Satellite: write r = R + h before touching GM. Derivation: draw the Δv triangle, state similarity, take the limit.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (5): centripetal acceleration definition + derivation. NEB 2023 (4): flywheel 0.5 m/300 rpm — ω, rim speed, a_c. NEB 2022 (3): car turn 50 m/10 m/s — ω and a_c. NEB 2022 (4): satellite 600 km orbit speed.
